select count(*) from monitor_order_event e where e.handle_status = 'pending'
mapper.update: update monitor_order_event set handle_status = 'pending', handle_note = null, handle_by = null, handle_time = null where site_code = #{scope.siteCode} and event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.select:
select e.rule_id as "ruleId", max(e.trigger_time) as "lastAt" from monitor_order_event e where e.rule_id in #{v}
group by e.rule_id
mapper.insert: insert into monitor_order_event ( site_code, rule_id, order_no, amount, cum_count, cum_amount, trigger_time, level, trigger_point, amount_mode, currency, notify_status, notify_reason, notify_chats, handle_status, report_by, create_time ) values ( #{siteCode}, #{ruleId}, #{orderNo}, #{amount}, #{cumCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{cumAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{triggerTime}, #{level}, #{triggerPoint,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{amountMode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{currency,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{notifyStatus}, #{notifyReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, coalesce(#{notifyChats,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '[]')::jsonb, 'pending', #{reportBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTime} ) on conflict (site_code, rule_id, order_no) do nothing
